bg-canvas.$description: Page canvas behind the app shell (the html element). The darkest layer. Not for cards or controls.

bg.$description: Default app background (body, top bar, main area). One step above the canvas. Not for cards; use surface.

surface.$description: Cards, panels, table bodies and inputs at rest. Move one layer at a time: bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-hover.

surface-raised.$description: Menus, popovers, selected rows and anything floating above a surface. Not for page backgrounds.

surface-hover.$description: Hover state of controls and list items: one step lighter than the resting surface. Do not use at rest.

surface-row-hover.$description: Hover background of table and list rows only; subtler than surface-hover so dense data stays calm. Not for buttons or menu items.

line-subtle.$description: Internal dividers inside a card or table (row separators). Decorative, so exempt from the 3:1 non-text contrast rule. Never use it as a control boundary.

line.$description: Default 1px border of cards and containers. Not for form control boundaries; use line-control.

line-strong.$description: Border of overlays, menus, popovers, dialogs and cards that must stand out. Not for form control boundaries (use line-control); it is below 3:1.

line-control.$description: Boundary of form controls: input, select, textarea, checkbox, radio and combobox triggers. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised (WCAG 1.4.11). New in TOK-004. Not for decorative dividers.

text.$description: Primary text and icons. Warm off-white, not pure white. Use for anything that must be read first.

text-2.$description: Secondary text: descriptions, supporting copy, inactive labels.

text-3.$description: Tertiary text: metadata, placeholders, hints. Meets 4.5:1 on every surface up to surface-hover. Do not use on surfaces lighter than surface-hover or on colored fills.

text-inverse.$description: Text and icons on solid light or signal fills (selected day in a calendar, solid badges). Not on dark surfaces.

primary-bg.$description: Fill of the primary button and the tooltip: light ink on a dark UI. One primary action per screen. Hover is brightness .88, not a new token.

primary-fg-muted.$description: Secondary text on primary-bg (for example the shortcut hint in a tooltip). Only valid on primary-bg.

accent.$description: The single accent: focus, selection, links and open states. Never a button fill or a large area. Always pair with text or a shape, never color alone.

success.$description: Success signal: done, saved, healthy. Always accompanied by text or an icon. Not decorative.

warning.$description: Warning signal: attention needed, nothing broken. Always accompanied by text or an icon.

danger.$description: Error and destructive signal: errors, delete buttons, invalid fields. Always accompanied by text or an icon.

accent-soft.$description: Tinted background for accent states (selected item, info). 14% accent over the surface beneath, resolved with color-mix so it adapts to the surface. Not for text.

success-soft.$description: Tinted background for success states (badge, banner). 14% success over the surface beneath. Not for text.

warning-soft.$description: Tinted background for warning states (badge, banner). 14% warning over the surface beneath. Not for text.

danger-soft.$description: Tinted background for error states (badge, banner, invalid field). 10% danger over the surface beneath. Not for text.

danger-soft-hover.$description: Hover state of danger-soft surfaces such as the ghost-danger button. 18% danger over the surface beneath.

danger-line.$description: Border of danger-tinted surfaces (error banner, destructive confirmation). 35% danger over the surface beneath. Not a form control boundary; invalid fields use danger.

overlay.$description: Backdrop behind dialogs. Flat, no blur. Not for side sheets; use scrim.

scrim.$description: Backdrop behind side sheets. Lighter than overlay so the page stays visible. Not for dialogs.

swatch-ring.$description: Inset 1px ring drawn inside color swatches and avatars so dark swatches stay visible on dark surfaces. Not a general border.

paper.$description: Paper surface of printed-document previews (receipt, PDF). The only light surface in the system; use inside [data-theme="paper"] only.

paper-ink.$description: Primary text on paper. Paper theme only.

paper-ink-2.$description: Secondary text on paper. Paper theme only.

paper-muted.$description: Tertiary text and control boundaries on paper (above 4.5:1 on paper). Paper theme only.

paper-rule.$description: Decorative rules and dividers on paper (table lines, totals). Below 3:1, so never a control boundary or text. Paper theme only.

paper-accent.$description: Accent on paper: links and highlighted figures (4.53:1 on paper). Darkened from #B8603E in TOK-004. Paper theme only.
